title: SLNS Vijayabahu rescues man drifting off Pothuvil
byline: The Sri Lanka Navy rescued a man who had gone missing at sea during a search and rescue operation conducted approximately 15 nautical miles off Pothuvil on Friday.

title: Central Province Governor says no response yet from President on resignation
byline: Central Province Governor Prof. Sarath Abeykoon says he has not yet received any response from President Anura Kumara Dissanayake to the letter informing him of his decision to resign from the post.

title: Sri Lanka Dengue Cases 2026: Live Tracker and Latest Updates
byline: Track the latest dengue cases, deaths, and regional trends across Sri Lanka through our regularly updated dashboard.

title: President discusses Negombo Prison unrest with prison officials
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake today held discussions with senior officials of the Department of Prisons, with special attention given to the recent unrest at the Negombo Prison and measures needed to prevent similar incidents in the future.

title: Kataragama to become ‘Polythene Free Sacred Zone - 2030’
byline: The Central Environmental Authority (CEA) has launched a five-year programme to make the Kataragama sacred city, sacred site and the surrounding areas of the Menik Ganga a plastic-free zone by 2030.

title: Sri Lanka calls for stronger regional cooperation at BIMSTEC Security Chiefs’ Meeting
byline: Sri Lanka has called for stronger regional cooperation to address emerging security challenges in the Bay of Bengal region, with Defence Secretary Air Vice Marshal Sampath Thuyacontha (Retd) emphasising the need for collective action among BIMSTEC member states.

title: Sri Lanka leads world in humane dog management
byline: Sri Lanka has become the first country in the world to complete LEAP Dog (Logical Evaluation and Action Plan for Dogs), a new international programme that helps countries develop humane and science-based plans to manage dog populations.

title: CSE ends lower as turnover falls to year’s lowest, ASPI holds key support
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange ended Friday’s session in negative territory, reversing the previous day’s gains as subdued trading activity and cautious investor sentiment weighed on market performance. The ASPI declined for the third consecutive test of the key 21,400 support level, which continued to hold despite persistent selling pressure.

title: US, Sri Lanka discuss stronger trade and maritime security ties
byline: The United States and Sri Lanka have reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening bilateral commercial relations and maritime security cooperation during a meeting between senior officials in Washington.

title: Ring attached to finger bone discovered at Chemmani Mass Grave
byline: During today’s excavation at the Chemmani mass grave, 11 new skeletal remains were identified. Among them, a copper ring still attached to a finger bone was also discovered.

title: Court orders arrest of Deputy Minister Eranga Gunasekara, MP Jagath Manuwarna
byline: The Fort Magistrate’s Court today (17) ordered the arrest of Deputy Minister of Urban Development Eranga Gunasekara, MP Jagath Manuwarna and four others after they failed to appear for a scheduled hearing.

title: US widens Iran strikes as Tehran hits Gulf states over Hormuz
byline: The United States expanded its airstrike campaign against Iran early Friday, hitting bridges, electrical equipment and a tower at a key port, as President Donald Trump stepped up pressure on Tehran over its hold on the Strait of Hormuz. Iran responded with fresh missile attacks on US-allied countries in the Middle East, including Qatar, while also targeting sites in Bahrain and Kuwait.

title: Court to hear intervention petitions in Suresh Sallay’s writ petition on August 4
byline: The Court of Appeal today fixed August 4 to hear several intervention petitions filed both in support of and in opposition to the writ application filed by former State Intelligence Service (SIS) Director Major General (Retired) Suresh Sallay.

title: Jacqueline Fernandez launches AI digital avatar
byline: Bollywood star Jacqueline Fernandez doesn’t just want to be appreciated for her looks. Instead, she wants to project the image of a reader and a reflective person. That’s why she is now launching an AI-based digital avatar.

title: Trump alleges China meddled in 2020 election and questions voting security ahead of midterms
byline: US President Donald Trump has delivered a primetime address in which he accused China of interfering in the 2020 election and alleged ’’shocking vulnerabilities’’ in American voting systems.

title: Pakistan spinner sanctioned for breaching ICC Anti-Doping Code
byline: Pakistan spin-bowling all-rounder Mohammad Nawaz has accepted a three-month period of ineligibility (which will be reduced to one month on completion of a substance of abuse treatment programme) for breaching the ICC Anti-Doping Code.

title: LPL 2026 to proceed as scheduled despite Jaffna Kings owner’s arrest
byline: Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) has confirmed that the Lanka Premier League (LPL) 2026 will commence as scheduled this evening at the SSC Grounds in Colombo, despite the reported arrest of a co-owner of the Jaffna Kings franchise by the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) for the Prevention of Offences Relating to Sports.

title: SDIG Waruna Jayasundara transferred
byline: Senior Deputy Inspector General of Police (SDIG) in charge of the Eastern Province, Waruna Jayasundara has been transferred as the Deputy Inspector General (DIG) in charge of the Police Children & Women Bureau, with effect from yesterday.

title: Andadola, Akurala railway sub-stations reopen after months of closure
byline: The Railways Department has reopened the Andadola and Akurala railway sub-stations, restoring ticketing and other passenger services after both stations remained closed for several months.

title: Saving street animals is everyone’s responsibility: PM
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya today said that protecting and saving the lives of street animals is a shared responsibility, urging the public to stop abandoning pets in public places and to show greater compassion towards stray animals.

title: School bus crash kills at least 20 pupils in Uganda
byline: At least 20 schoolchildren and one adult have been killed after a bus carrying pupils on a study trip crashed in eastern Uganda, local officials say, in one of the country’s deadliest road accidents involving children in recent years.

title: More than 500 Rohingya vanished at sea - what happened?
byline: Two boats carrying an estimated 530 Rohingya asylum seekers left Myanmar’s Rakhine state on 29 June, and have not been heard from since. The equivalent of a jumbo jet full of people has vanished.

title: Rakitha, Charitha and Aruna further remanded
byline: Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S. Bodaragama today ordered the further remand of Attorney-at-Law Rakitha Nirmala Rajapaksha, Samagi Jana Balawegaya Horana organiser Charitha Wasantha Kumara Abeysinghe, and former Civil Aviation Authority Airport Director Varushahennadige Aruna Sri Chathuranga until July 28.

title: Jaffna Kings team owner arrested over alleged match-fixing
byline: A team owner of the Lanka Premier League (LPL) franchise Jaffna Kings has been arrested by the Sri Lanka Police Special Investigation Unit for the Prevention of Offences Relating to Sports over alleged match-fixing offences.

title: Former IGP C.D. Wickremaratne dies in suspected suicide
byline: Former Inspector General of Police (IGP) C.D. Wickramaratne has died at the age of 63, in what is being reported as a suspected suicide.

title: CAA sets mandatory aflatoxin limit for processed liquid milk from January 2027
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) has introduced a new regulation requiring all processed liquid milk sold in Sri Lanka to comply with the maximum permissible aflatoxin limit from January 8, 2027.

title: Iran targets military bases as US launches wave of strikes
byline: Tehran has launched fresh attacks on US military bases in neighbouring Gulf states, while Washington continued to strike sites across Iran overnight.

title: US denies Iranian claims it hit civilian infrastructure in latest strikes
byline: The US has denied Iranian accusations that it hit civilian infrastructure in the latest wave of air strikes since peace talks collapsed.

title: Constable interdicted for allegedly sitting on WPC’s lap
byline: A constable attached to the Makulugaswewa Police Station has been interdicted following allegations of misconduct involving a Woman Police Constable (WPC) while on duty.

title: West Indies legend Sobers dies aged 89
byline: Legendary former West Indies all-rounder Sir Garfield Sobers, regarded as one of the greatest cricketers of all time, has died aged 89.

title: Heat Index expected to reach caution level in several areas
byline: The Department of Meteorology has issued a warm weather advisory for the Eastern Province and the districts of Jaffna, Kilinochchi, Mullaitivu, Vavuniya and Monaragala for today (18).

title: British mother accused of abducting sons from American father in cross-border custody dispute
byline: A British mother has been accused of abducting her two young sons from the United States after allegedly failing to return them to their American father following a court-approved visit to the United Kingdom, according to a report published by The Telegraph.

title: Dengue deaths in 2026 top 50, surpassing 2025’s total of 29
byline: Sri Lanka has recorded 50 dengue-related deaths in the first seven months of 2026, already exceeding the 29 deaths reported during the whole of 2025, as the country’s dengue outbreak continues to worsen with infections climbing to 73,455.

title: PTA accused granted bail after 15 years
byline: The Court of Appeal has granted bail to a man who had remained in remand custody for nearly 15 years under the Prevention of Terrorism Act (PTA), ruling that such prolonged pre-trial detention amounted to an exceptional circumstance warranting his release.

title: Trump threatens new Canada tariffs over fires sending ’filthy’ air into US cities
byline: US President Donald Trump has threatened to impose new tariffs on Canada after hundreds of wildfires have left much of the northern US covered by a blanket of smoke.

title: Over 4,600 cases filed over mosquito breeding sites so far in 2026
byline: Police have filed 4,672 court cases against individuals for maintaining premises conducive to mosquito breeding during the period from January to June 2026, the Police said.

title: 5.0 magnitude earthquake hits eastern Turkey
byline: There are currently no reports of any adverse circumstances,’’ and an ’’on-site assessment’’ is ongoing, Turkey’s Disaster and Emergency Management Authority said

title: Angolan woman nabbed at BIA with Rs. 10m cocaine concealed inside body
byline: A 54-year-old Angolan woman has been arrested by the Sri Lanka Customs Narcotics Control Unit for allegedly attempting to smuggle cocaine worth more than Rs. 10 million into the country by concealing the drug inside her body.

title: Supermarket fined Rs. 1Mn for selling Keeri Samba above MRP
byline: A supermarket in Beruwala has been fined Rs. 1 million for selling locally produced Keeri Samba rice above the government-mandated Maximum Retail Price (MRP).

title: US denies Iranian claims it hit civilian infrastructure in latest strikes
byline: The US has denied Iranian accusations that it hit civilian infrastructure in the latest wave of air strikes since peace talks collapsed.

title: Over 700 arrested in islandwide ‘Ratama Ekata’ operation
byline: A total of 706 individuals were arrested yesterday (July 17) during the islandwide “Ratama Ekata” national operation.

title: House of Fashions owner remanded after Customs arrest
byline: House of Fashions owner and Managing Director Preethi Jayawardena has been arrested over an alleged Customs violation and remanded while receiving treatment at the National Hospital in Colombo after developing a heart-related medical condition.

title: Kuwait International Airport suspends operations temporarily
byline: Takeoff and landing operations have been temporarily suspended at Kuwait International Airport, Kuwait’s national carrier announced on Saturday, adding that it rescheduled most of its flights due to the measure, Anadolu Ajansi (AA) reported.

title: Roshan Mahanama clarifies Dambulla Sixers role amid conflict of interest concerns
byline: Former Sri Lanka cricketer Roshan Mahanama has clarified concerns raised over a possible conflict of interest regarding his role as team mentor of the Dambulla Sixers in the 2026 Lanka Premier League (LPL) and his position as a member of the Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) Transformation Committee.
